title: Stand up the Customer web surface and its static half
objective: Give Kafoo a place a Customer reaches without installing anything: the web app, a kitchen page, a Meal page, and a shared reference that previews correctly. ADR-0008 Amendment 1.
acceptance_criteria: Next.js and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, deploying from a build
a kitchen page shows exactly the five public details and no sixth; a kitchen with nothing on offer is not reachable
the shared reference previews exactly name, area and photo (FR-027a); no rating, review count or order count appears anywhere (FR-027c)
the build fails if a service-role key reaches the bundle — verify.sh catches a tracked key and a bundle is not a tracked file
verify.sh's vocabulary, localization-parity and synthetic-content checks cover apps/web/ BEFORE its strings ship (T196 before T180)
the web deploy job is restored in deploy.yml, written against a surface that now exists
notes:
Runs from day one alongside WP-011 — analyze corrected an earlier claim that this waited on search. The scaffold, the kitchen page, the Meal page and the preview read what E2 already published under policies that already exist. Only browse-and-search on the web waits, and that is WP-018. Its own messages live in apps/web/messages/, so it does NOT collide with the app's ARB files. It does change verify.sh, which every other package depends on to know whether it passed — hence the shared declaration and the low priority number rather than EXCLUSIVE, since the change is additive.

DELEGATION SUSPENDED 2026-08-06 by the founder: the OpenCode weekly limit is reached. Do this package's work directly and do NOT dispatch to opencode-delegate or claude-delegate until the founder says otherwise. suggested_model and spend_envelope_usd are kept as the plan for when it resumes; they are not permission to spend today.

DELIVERED 2026-08-06 overnight. apps/web builds at 106 kB first load against the Flutter web target's 42 MB — the number ADR-0008 was arguing about, now measured. Every page is server-rendered and nothing client-side talks to Supabase, so the publishable key never reaches the browser at all; ADR-0008 permits it in a bundle and not shipping one is simply better and free here. The preview cap is a pure function with mutation-tested assertions rather than a comment: a fourth field on KitchenPreview and a rating rendered on the page each turn lib/preview.test.mjs red. Extending the gate to read apps/web immediately caught 'two vendors' in a comment I had written.

NOT DONE: no deploy has run. The job is restored in deploy.yml and gated on CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, warning out loud when it is unset rather than reporting a skip as a success — but nothing has been published and the adapter has never run against real Cloudflare.
